title: Is it still the same ship?
summary: If every plank of a ship is replaced over time, is it the same ship? The Ship of Theseus puzzle has no settled answer — and it applies to people too.

scenes.text: Replace every plank of a ship, one by one. Is it still the same ship?
scenes.answer: Philosophers have argued about this for around 2,000 years.

scenes.text: Plutarch wrote that Athenians preserved the hero Theseus's ship, replacing rotting timbers with new ones.
Centuries later, Thomas Hobbes added a twist.
scenes.reveal: What if someone kept the old planks and rebuilt the original? Which ship is the real one?

items.title: Same material
items.detail: The rebuilt ship is the original

items.title: Continuity
items.detail: The repaired ship, because it changed gradually

items.title: It depends
items.detail: 'Same' depends on what we care about

scenes.text: Many of your body's cells are replaced over the years. Are you still the same person?
Identity may be less about parts and more about continuity.
